xelray.drop.sub: Straight from a hospital CD — the whole DICOM folder works.
xelray.drop.title: Drop DICOM files or folder here
xelray.error.hint: Use ↑ and ↓ to move to another image.
xelray.error.title: This image could not be shown
xelray.fit.tip: Reset zoom and position (0, or double-click the image)
xelray.help.fnkeys: Home, End, PageUp and PageDown also work, if your keyboard has them without holding Fn.
xelray.help.mouse: Mouse — wheel steps images, ctrl+wheel zooms, double-click fits. Drag to set brightness; once zoomed in, drag moves the image instead and Shift+drag sets brightness. Middle-drag always moves.
xelray.help.overlays: Show / hide text over the image
xelray.help.trackpad: Trackpad — two-finger scroll steps images, pinch zooms. Touch — swipe to step, pinch to zoom, drag to move when zoomed.
xelray.no_dicom: No DICOM files found in that drop.
xelray.none_readable: None of those {total} files were readable DICOM.
xelray.open_another.tip: Close this study and choose different files
xelray.privacy: Files are processed locally in your browser and never uploaded.
xelray.rail.hide_panel: Hide this panel — the image fills the window (S)
xelray.scrub.tip: Drag to move through the images
xelray.shortcuts.tip: List every keyboard shortcut (? or H)
xelray.some_ignored: {skipped} of {total} files were not DICOM and were ignored.
xelray.text.tip: Show or hide the name, date and numbers over the image (O)
xelray.warn.unsupported: Compressed with {codec}, which this build cannot read. Images cannot be shown.
xelray.window.tip: Drag on the image to fine-tune
